market_summary: The broader market reflects positive momentum driven by strong order wins in defense, capital goods, and infrastructure alongside active M&A activity across industrial sectors. Capital deployment via strategic acquisitions and corporate actions (bonus/dividends) highlights corporate confidence in mid-to-long term earnings visibility.
top_pick_reason: Bharat Electronics displays superior earnings visibility driven by constant defense order inflows, combined with an outstanding balance sheet and strong sovereign tailwinds.
